title: Demo.Vault
tagline: Vault.demo is a digital gallery that provides marketplace and vault functions for collecting and preserving digital artifacts: 'demos' in the case of this hackathon.'
description: This project is meant to pay homage to early builders and demos that have headlined the most fantastic innovations of our time in the digital sphere. Our main product feature will be to allow folks to collect their favourite demos as NFTs via the *markeptlace* feature which is in itself is a way of supporting early builders of innovative products. One additional feature is the *vault* function which we allow folks to keep demos live on-chain via community-DAO
how_its_made: Our product will allow folks to collect their favourite demos as NFTs via the *markeptlace* feature which is in itself is a way of supporting early builders of innovative products. Our additional feature is the *vault* function which we allow folks to keep demos. Tech we are thinking of using: Filecoin - FVM, Livepeer, Spheron
